scope: Release comparison with two historical controls and a post-hoc mixed coverage replacement view. Not a uniform coverage_v2 60-attempt benchmark.

method.name: Two comparison views: frozen formal results and post-hoc replacement summary
method.construction: Keep 47 original accepted coverage_v1 attempts; replace every original unsuccessful slot with its corresponding coverage_v2 rerun, including the new failed attempt. No best-of selection.
method.primary: Only accepted reports contribute quality numerator; all 60 slots stay in the coverage denominator.
method.limits: Mixed historical/new configurations with failure-selected development reruns. Not a uniform new 60-attempt benchmark. Controls and historical judgments unchanged; no new API calls.
